close_reason: Clarified Link.href rustdoc with explicit citation of the spec authority for the Option<String> deviation from RFC 8984 §1.4.11 'mandatory': the JMAP Calendars draft (draft-ietf-jmap-calendars-26 §5.3) relaxes the mandate when blob_id is set. The deviation is correct given this crate's consumption by jmap-calendars-types — the docstring rewrite makes the spec authority discoverable so a future reviewer doesn't re-raise the same finding.
description:
src/lib.rs:321-322 declares Link.href as Option<String> with an inline comment citing draft-ietf-jmap-calendars-26 §5.3 / §10.9.14 ('blobId may be set instead of href for server-stored attachments'). The justification is technically correct: the JMAP Calendars draft does relax the RFC 8984 mandate when blobId is present.

But this crate's stated scope (per Cargo.toml description, PLAN.md §15, README.md ¶1, and AGENTS.md) is 'RFC 8984 JSCalendar typed sub-types'. The crate is intended to be consumed by both jmap-calendars-types AND jmap-tasks-types (per PLAN.md and bd:JMAP-yfpq). Pre-leaking a Calendars-specific draft relaxation into the shared sub-types crate has two consequences:

1. The Tasks consumer (which does not rely on draft-ietf-jmap-calendars-26 §5.3 — Task attachments are handled differently per draft-ietf-jmap-tasks-06) inherits a permissive Link.href shape that the Tasks spec itself does not relax. Future tasks-server code that round-trips a Link with href:None will be silently constructing wire data that is invalid per Tasks draft + RFC 8984, and the type system will not catch it.

2. The crate's contract drifts from 'pure RFC 8984' to 'RFC 8984 plus a specific JMAP-Calendars relaxation'. A future contributor reading PLAN.md and assuming pure-8984 will be surprised.

Two reasonable resolutions:

(a) Make href:String mandatory in this crate, push the Option<String> override to jmap-calendars-types via a sibling Link type or a wrapper. Cleanest but most invasive.

(b) Keep the current shape but update PLAN.md, README.md, and AGENTS.md to call out the deviation explicitly: 'Link.href is Option<String> rather than the RFC-mandated String, to allow the JMAP-Calendars §5.3 blobId substitution. Consumers of this crate that do not honor the Calendars relaxation MUST treat href:None as a binding error.'

Recommendation: (b) — the cost of (a) is high (Link is widely used) and the relaxation is well-precedented. But the documentation gap needs closing.
title: Link.href typed Option<String> deviates from RFC 8984 §1.4.11 'mandatory' for purported pure-RFC-8984 crate
